scope: The eps_m canonical-cocycle obstruction is the quadratic form Q(sum n_j[w_j]) = sum n_j e(w_j) e(1-w_j) mod 24 on residue-field Teichmuller dlogs; the closed form r(w) = e(w) mod m is VALIDATED against every measured shift in the merged p-adic sweep. Q mod 2 is a Bloch-class invariant (five-term, reflection and inversion relations are all even, swept exhaustively over F_25) but Q mod 24 is NOT -- relations realize every even shift. Since Q(xi) = 10 is even, a representative with Q = 0 exists and is exhibited explicitly with K-rational lifts, giving an integral canonical cocycle SIMULTANEOUSLY at every m | 24. This CONFIRMS the merged scope-(b) alpha exclusion was correctly scoped to one representative and is not a barrier to eps_m. Extracting the eps_m VALUES at m >= 3 needs the p-adic descent re-run on the 7-symbol representative -- the next increment, not done here.
